basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of San Francisco’s prestigious Parnassus Heights, 64-66 Woodland Ave is a stunning duplex building, blending timeless elegance with modern convenience. Built in 1906, this meticulously maintained property showcases original period details, including built-in cabinetry, coffered ceilings, and a charming tiled fireplace. The 3 unit building features two spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath flats and a delightful non-warranted 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit in the basement level.  The top-floor flat boasts a formal dining/living room combo, a separate family room, a cozy fireplace, in-unit laundry, and bedrooms thoughtfully positioned at opposite ends for added privacy. Enjoy serene views from the private rear deck. The first-floor flat offers a combined living/dining area, a fireplace, an eat-in kitchen, and two adjacent bedrooms, complemented by a private deck. The enchanting garden cottage exudes historic charm with built-in cabinetry, a spacious eat-in kitchen, an updated bathroom, and classic period details.  Additional amenities include a shared basement, laundry and ample storage space. Perfectly situated just steps from vibrant Cole Valley shops and restaurants, UCSF, MUNI, Goldman Tennis Center, Golden Gate Park, and Mt. Sutro Open Space.
